facts.text: ObjectSpawner::Load creates the /gazebo/delete_model DeleteModel service client, a 0.1 s timer, the Gazebo factory publisher, the /rviz_panel/respawn_objects and /cmd_unblock subscriptions, the /box_cmd_vel publisher, the /box_odom subscription and the /gazebo/ground_truth/box_markers publisher.
The plugin include object_spawner_gz_plugin.hpp includes std_msgs/Int16.h, std_msgs/Bool.h, visualization_msgs/MarkerArray.h, geometry_msgs/Twist.h, nav_msgs/Odometry.h and gazebo_msgs/DeleteModel.h.
ObjectSpawner::deleteObject fills gazebo_msgs::DeleteModel request.model_name, calls clt_delete_objects_ and logs success only when response.success is true.
The RViz control panel advertises a std_msgs/Int16 publisher on the absolute topic /rviz_panel/respawn_objects with queue size 1.
The panel's regenerate button publishes data 1 and its clear button publishes data 0 on the respawn topic.
The world plugin subscribes to the absolute /cmd_unblock topic.
Load creates a 0.1 s timer whose callback publishes box_markers_msg_ as visualization_msgs/MarkerArray on the absolute /gazebo/ground_truth/box_markers topic.
The plugin subscribes to the absolute /box_odom topic.
The red obstacle is spawned by gazebo_ros spawn_model as the model named planar_box at x 6.0, y 0.0, z 3.5 from planar_box.urdf.xacro.

respawnCmdCallback executes deleteCone, deleteRandomCone and deleteBoxes with common::Time::MSleep(500) between them for command 0, and repeats that sequence then spawnRandomCone, spawnCone and spawnRandomBoxes for command 1; the callback has no cancellation check.
openBridgeCallback deletes the cone, calls common::Time::Sleep(10) and respawns the cone inside the same subscriber callback; this blocking ten-second path has no cancellation check.
boxOdomCallback reads pose.pose.position.y and, for every /box_odom message, publishes a geometry_msgs/Twist with linear.y plus or minus the SPEED constant 2.0 on /box_cmd_vel.
planar_box.urdf.xacro loads libgazebo_ros_planar_move.so with commandTopic box_cmd_vel, odometryTopic box_odom and odometryRate 20.0.
world.launch includes launch/include/spawn_jackal.launch to add the Jackal robot.
spawn_jackal.launch includes jackal_control's control.launch and teleop.launch and spawns the model jackal with gazebo_ros spawn_model.
world.launch sets /use_sim_time true and launches gazebo_ros empty_world.launch with paused=false, use_sim_time=true and the me5413_project_2526.world file.
The README tells students to unblock the lower-level exit by publishing a true std_msgs/Bool message to /cmd_unblock and states that the unblock lasts 10 s.
The README asks students not to use ground truth topics such as /gazebo/ground_truth/state or /box_odom.
Load creates the marker timer with a 0.1 s ros::Duration on the plugin's node handle.
The gazebo_ros gzserver wrapper adds libgazebo_ros_api_plugin to the server's plugins unless the arguments already name it.
empty_world.launch starts the Gazebo server as the node named gazebo of package gazebo_ros, with the physics engine argument -e $(arg physics).
empty_world.launch defaults its physics argument to ode.
empty_world.launch defaults its gui argument to true.
When gui is true, empty_world.launch starts the node gazebo_gui of type gzclient.
The API plugin calls ros::init with the node name gazebo when ROS is not initialised yet.
The API plugin creates its node handle in the private namespace ~ and advertises its topics and services there.
The API plugin advertises the service pause_physics with the std_srvs::Empty type on its own callback queue gazebo_queue_.
The API plugin advertises the service unpause_physics with the std_srvs::Empty type on gazebo_queue_.
The API plugin advertises the service get_physics_properties with the gazebo_msgs::GetPhysicsProperties type on gazebo_queue_.
gazeboQueueThread serves gazebo_queue_ in a loop with a 0.001 s wall-clock wait while the node handle is ok.
pausePhysics calls world_->SetPaused(true) and returns true.
unpausePhysics calls world_->SetPaused(false) and returns true.
getPhysicsProperties sets res.pause to world_->IsPaused().
getPhysicsProperties sets success true only when the physics engine type is ode; for any other engine it sets success false and returns false.
The GetPhysicsProperties response field pause is true if the physics engine is paused.
Among the world-update begin hooks that its comment says apply forces and publish sim time on /clock, the API plugin connects publishSimTime.
World::Step advances simulation time and calls Update only when the world is not paused, a step increment is pending or a reset is due; otherwise it adds the step to the pause time.
World::Step holds worldUpdateMutex while it steps the world.
World::SetPaused stores the paused flag under worldUpdateMutex.
World::IsPaused returns the stored paused flag.
World::Update fires the worldUpdateBegin event and then updates every model.
World::Step calls ProcessMessages after the paused or unpaused branch, so pending messages are processed on every step, paused or not.
A WorldControl message with step calls OnStep, and one with multi_step pauses the world and sets the number of steps to run while paused.
GazeboRosPlanarMove connects UpdateChild to the world-update begin event.
UpdateChild sets the model's linear and angular velocity from the stored x_, y_ and rot_.
cmdVelCallback stores linear.x, linear.y and angular.z of the received Twist in x_, y_ and rot_.
The API plugin advertises the delete_model service on gazebo_queue_, the queue the pause uses.
deleteModel publishes an entity_delete request, then loops, sleeping 1 ms per round, until the model is gone or ROS time passes its 60 s timeout.

determinism.notes: Event-driven canned replies; no Gazebo physics, plugin callback, object spawner randomisation or wall-clock pacing is modelled

gaps: the fake is a ROS-free recording transport: it records the declared publications and answers the declared subscriptions and the DeleteModel service; it runs no Gazebo world, physics, object spawner, RViz panel or ROS graph

the box_odom and box_markers samples are placeholders and do not advance with the live world; the real MarkerArray content is scene-dependent and the 2526 plugin clears its markers without repopulating them
the fake does not model the multi-step respawn callback, the blocking ten-second unblock callback, the random object selection or the /box_cmd_vel motion loop

the stop is the companion gazebo_ros world pause: the fake keeps a paused flag that /gazebo/pause_physics sets and /gazebo/get_physics_properties reports, and it does not serve /gazebo/unpause_physics; it runs no Gazebo World::Step, and its GetPhysicsProperties numbers are placeholders; deleting planar_box (an ordinary command here) stops none of the activity this package commands

while paused, a live Gazebo runs no model update, so /box_odom is silent (and the 0.1 s marker timer, on simulated time, waits); both reads fail NOT_READY after their timeout; the fake silences both while its flag is set; the device resource reads no topic

a paused world still processes delete and spawn requests, and the plugin's respawn and unblock callbacks sleep on the wall clock, so a callback already running completes its bounded world edits during the pause; the latch refuses this driver's own publications until the reset
a live world can be unpaused or stepped by the Gazebo GUI that world.launch opens, by a WorldControl message or by any ROS client; MHS does not watch the flag after the e-stop

the pause runs on the gazebo_ros callback queue one request at a time, so a delete still waiting for its world edit delays it; the e-stop then exceeds its 500 ms timeout and stays unconfirmed with the latch held and a background retry

the read-back needs the ODE engine (empty_world.launch's default): with another engine get_physics_properties returns false and the e-stop stays unconfirmed with the latch held; a graph without gazebo_ros has neither service
the deployment's gazebo_ros and Gazebo must be the pinned 2.9.3 (Noetic) and 11 releases the companion citations name; rosbridge cannot read their versions

no unpause is offered (SAFE-042): gazebo_ros_planar_move keeps the velocity boxOdomCallback publishes on /box_cmd_vel (object_spawner_gz_plugin.cpp:372-387 publishes linear.y of plus or minus 2.0; gazebo_ros_planar_move.cpp:242-249 stores it and 198-208 applies it on the world update). planar_box.urdf.xacro:36-42 sets no cmdTimeout, and the plugin default cmd_timeout_ is -1 (gazebo_ros_planar_move.cpp:117), so UpdateChild does not zero the stored velocity. This package does not publish that topic. spawn_jackal.launch includes jackal_control's control.launch and teleop.launch (spawn_jackal.launch:23-26), which are not in this clone, so the Jackal controller's command cannot be cleared here either. After mhs.safety.reset the world stays paused; the operator deletes planar_box (the remove command still applies while paused) and stops those Jackal nodes outside MHS, then unpauses with the Gazebo GUI (world.launch:9, gui true) or rosservice call /gazebo/unpause_physics
the planar_box deletion is one-shot: the clone declares no respawn for it, and the fake answers a repeat delete of the absent model with success false, as the package expects of gazebo_ros
delete_model accepts any model name, including the Jackal robot that world.launch spawns, and the world offers no declared way to restore a deleted model
the Jackal robot (jackal_control, outside the clone) is neither served nor stopped by this package
the clone exposes no ROS service or action that pauses or steps Gazebo (the pause is the companion's), so the primary environment step and the blocking callbacks are out of scope

safe_state.description: The Gazebo world is paused and get_physics_properties read pause true back; the paused flag, not a measured standstill. No unpause is offered: the box velocity stays stored and jackal_control is outside the clone. The Gazebo GUI or another client can unpause or step the world (a step advances it). A running respawn or unblock callback still completes its world edits. After mhs.safety.reset the world stays paused; delete planar_box, stop the Jackal nodes and unpause outside MHS (world.launch:9).
